details: Nearest positive and negative distances are the original retained float32 squared distances; the reported margin is negative distance minus positive distance with no rescaling, clipping, or prediction-statistic denominator.

details: This is one MSVR310 normal-input cached diagnostic with five outlets, 591 queries, 1,055 gallery items, 52 query identities, eight cameras, 30 observed query scenes, and historical seed 42. It is not a new method evaluation, new training run, missing-input result, or multi-seed confirmation.

R uses the original DeMo teacher and a 5,120D final descriptor. AH retains the separate full strong shared teacher and a 5,632D final interface. The source and retained metadata support treating their differences as cross-model comparisons rather than one-factor causal ablations.
R common_context is the 512D tail of the base identity descriptor captured at the calibrator input. It is separate from every F expert tensor and is not a frequency-expert result.
Historical checkpoints are benchmark-mAP selected. Reusing them is explicitly described; the diagnostic does not create an untouched-test claim.

Rescue/harm labels and image selection use evaluation GT offline. They do not establish an inference-time oracle, trained selector, causal fusion effect, or recoverability by a new decoder. The analysis already discloses these limits.
